appDescription: A demanding inland and waterway stage from Krokstorp to Mörtfors. The route leaves the Krokstorp cabin area, follows Tunaåsen, passes Skälshult old mill and Ölvedal, then follows the Marströmmen/Götehult water landscape toward Lilla Ramm, Ramnebo and Mörtfors. The finish has the Mörtfors bathing place, reserve access, bus access at E22 and the former bathhouse used as Ostkustleden cabin. Use care with water claims at both cabins: Krokstorp well water can be unreliable, and Mörtfors cabin potable water was not clearly confirmed in this pass.

camping: Krokstorp cabin and tenting by the cabin are official overnight options, with current maintainer sources listing 100 SEK/person in cabin and 50 SEK/person for tenting.
Mörtfors cabin is the official Etapp 4 endpoint cabin; same standard cabin/tenting fee pattern applies, but condition/currentness caveats should be shown internally before publication.
Ölvedal and Mörtfors reserve rules limit tenting/anchoring to no more than one day in the same place; check exact reserve boundaries during normalization.
fire: Krokstorp cabin page: no fires in fireplaces and no outdoor fires.
Mörtfors cabin page: no fireplaces and no outside fire.
Mörtfors naturreservat: fire only at designated places, in brought grill or outdoor stove.
Mörtfors badplats has a documented grill place, but use is subject to current fire bans and local rules.
No municipal/county fire ban was found at the rules check time, but fire risk was flagged and this is time-sensitive.
toilets: Krokstorp toilet is implied by cabin/Etapp 3 context but a separate exact coordinate remains unverified in the Etapp 4 pass.
Mörtfors has a cabin-side toilet and at least one Naturkartan endpoint-area toilet marker; duplicate handling is needed before import.
Mörtfors badplats toilet is seasonal according to municipal bathing-place information.

closuresAndReroutes.notes: No Etapp 4-specific official closure, forestry closure or reroute found. Naturkartan duplicate-language page still showed a hunting notice for the 2025/2026 moose season, likely stale seasonal safety text by 2026-04-29.

dogs.summary: Dogs need extra control March 1-August 20 under national rules and must be leashed in the relevant reserves; leash near grazing animals, avoid yards/plantings/crops and close gates.

hunting.summary: The 2025/2026 moose season was October 8-January 31 and was not active on 2026-04-29. Treat old Naturkartan hunting notices as stale unless physical signage or current notices say otherwise.

fire.summary: No Oskarshamn/Kalmar fire ban was found at check time, but fire risk was flagged and cabin/reserve rules are stricter than general allemansrätt. Recheck before publication or seasonal use.

waterAndBathing.summary: No Krokstorp/Marströmmen/Mörtfors municipal drinking-water protection conflict was identified. County water-status page said no county-wide irrigation ban, but large groundwater reservoirs were very low on its 2026-03-20 update. Mörtfors bathing-water records had acceptable 2025 samples and no 2026 sampling yet.

difficultyAndTrailFollowing.summary: Official difficulty is red/demanding. Field reports and whole-route reviews support caution for rough natural tread, stony/undulating terrain and occasional route-finding mismatches between digital lines and markings.

sourceContradictions.details: Official page notes damp smell after old water damage; a 2025 third-party report describes roof leakage, dampness and mold smell; a 2017 field report was more positive.

sourceContradictions.details: Krokstorp has official well/lake-water wording but field reports warn of poor water quality. Mörtfors cabin water is not clearly documented as potable in the gathered sources.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Keep Krokstorp as pending/unreliable water metadata and do not import Mörtfors cabin water until verified.

researchIterations.synthesisDecision: Six lanes produced enough official, geometry, facility, transit, field and rules evidence for a research-ready section file. No additional agent batch needed; remaining issues are explicit pre-import caveats.
